calendar.matters:
NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Jul-30-2019 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and a Minor.
Dept. 514. Judge: Gail Dekreon. Clerk: K. Dougherty. Proceedings Not Reported.

Petitioners Zhixing Chen and Runzhi Cai were was present in pro per.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of names were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petitions are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petitions should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Adult to Leo Zhixing Chen.
Additionally, the Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to Alyssa Yunqi Chen

Decrees Changing Name were submitted to and signed by the Court.
